# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

**DISCLAIMER**: The study is currently undergoing peer-review. Therefore, the code base is under active development. It includes code for all data presented in the manuscript but also exploratory data analysis parts. File paths have to be adjusted by the user.

# Single-cell analysis - General classification

Here, we will perform the second single cell analysis steps, including phenotyping immune and stromal cells.

## Read in data

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_04_ccRCC.rds")

sce

# read in again
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_05_ccRCC.rds")
```


## Filter sce for immune cells

```{r filter sce, message=FALSE}
#based on analysis categories
sce <- sce[,colData(sce)$analysis_cat == "non_tumor"]
sce
```

# 1. GMM 

## GMM scores per immune subtype

```{r}
## For non_epithelial cells 

# Convert the data.frame 
data_dt <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select("CD31_vWF_GMM","SMA_GMM", "CD3_GMM","CD4_GMM","CD8a_GMM","CD38_GMM","MPO_GMM","CD11c_GMM","CD20_GMM", "CD68_GMM")

type_markers <- c("CD31/vWF","SMA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")
rowData(sce)$GMM_immune <- rownames(sce) %in% type_markers

data_numeric <- data_dt %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(str_detect(., "TRUE"))))

data_numeric_out <- data_numeric %>% 
  mutate(CD11c_CD68_GMM = ifelse(CD11c_GMM | CD68_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% # Macro = CD11c or CD68
  mutate(CD11c_CD68_GMM = ifelse(MPO_GMM, 0, CD11c_CD68_GMM)) %>% # Neutro = MPO (independent of CD11c or CD68)
  mutate(CD3_CD4_GMM = ifelse(CD3_GMM & CD4_GMM, 1, 0)) %>% # CD4 = CD3 AND CD4
  dplyr::select(-CD11c_GMM,-CD68_GMM, -CD3_GMM, -CD4_GMM) %>% 
  mutate(sum = rowSums(.)) %>% filter(sum == 1) %>% 
  rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>% 
  pivot_longer(2:9, names_to = "GMM", values_to = "count") %>% 
  filter(count == 1) %>% dplyr::select(cell_id, GMM)

data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD31_vWF_GMM"] <- "Endothelial"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "SMA_GMM"] <- "Stromal"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD3_CD4_GMM"] <- "CD4_T_cell"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD8a_GMM"] <- "CD8_T_cell"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD38_GMM"] <- "Plasma_cell"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "MPO_GMM"] <- "Neutrophil"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD20_GMM"] <- "B_cell"
data_numeric_out$GMM[data_numeric_out$GMM == "CD11c_CD68_GMM"] <- "Macrophage"

#Add to sce
sce$GMM_immune_combined <- data_numeric_out$GMM[match(sce$cell_id, data_numeric_out$cell_id)]

sce$GMM_immune_combined[is.na(sce$GMM_immune_combined)] <- "Unknown/Other"

# GMM per category
GMM_sum <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(GMM_immune_combined) %>% dplyr::count()
GMM_sum

classification_sum <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(celltype) %>% dplyr::count()

GMM_sum
classification_sum
```

# 2. Clustering

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_05_ccRCC.rds")
```

## Define markers for clustering

```{r immune_markers, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# We will again use predefined markers 

rowData(sce)$sub_cluster <- rownames(sce) %in% c("CD31/vWF","SMA","CD45RO", "CD45RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")
```

## Run clustering

### Graph-based 

Next, we will run Rphenoannoy (Jaccard-based weights, Louvain clustering as community detection algorithm) clustering with different resolution parameters. 

Final clustering decision
```{r cluster, message=FALSE}
library(Rphenoannoy)
set.seed(22)

mat <- t(assay(sce, "exprs")[rowData(sce)$sub_cluster,])

#k=110
out <- Rphenoannoy(mat, k = 110)

clusters <- factor(membership(out[[2]]))

sce$cluster_110 <- clusters

unique(sce$cluster_110)

#Save SCEs after clustering
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_05_ccRCC.rds")

gc()

```

Clusterings not used

### Cluster stability testing and comparison

```{r}
#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]
# sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_05_ccRCC.rds")

# change name from 04_broad classification clustering
sce$cluster_04broad_23 <- sce$cluster_23
sce$cluster_23 <- NULL


my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sce))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sce)),"cluster_[:digit:]")]

my_clusters <- my_clusters[str_detect(my_clusters, "30|50|70|90|110|130")]

df <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sce, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sce)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,2]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "cluster")
}


p_num_clus_pheno <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=num_clus, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, num_clus), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, num_clus))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")

p_rmsd_pheno <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=rmsd, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, rmsd), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, rmsd))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")+
  labs(x="cluster size", y="RMSD")


p_sil_pheno <- ggplot(df, aes(x=k, y=sil, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  labs(x="cluster size", y="silhouette width")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  
p_num_clus_pheno+p_rmsd_pheno+p_sil_pheno
```

### Heatmap

```{r}
# By cluster 
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_110, #dplyr::select cluster of interest
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$sub_cluster)

h_phenograph <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")), 
        name = "min_max",
        col = viridis(100), 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max"))),
          name = "scaled min_max")+
  rowAnnotation(id = anno_text(mean_sce$ids))+
  rowAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(mean_sce$ncells, gp = gpar(fill = 1)))
```



# 3. Astir for automated cell type assignment 

### Astir model

see [here](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2405471221003355?via%3Dihub) for full publication (Geuenich et al.,2021, Cell Systems).

```{r astir-expo}
#Export arsinh normalized expression matrix as csv
expr_astir <- assay(sce,"exprs") %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(PID = sce$PID)

write.csv(expr_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/expr_ccRCC_immune_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)


#Export design matrix 
design_astir <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID)

write.csv(design_astir, file = "/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/design_ccRCC_immune_astir.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```

`Next: Run Astir in Python.`

```{r astir-ana, message = FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#Import Astir cell type assignments
astir_type <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/astir_ccRCC_immune_celltypes_TME.csv",col_names = c("ID","cell_type"),skip = 1)

astir_sum <- astir_type %>% as.data.frame %>% group_by(cell_type) %>% dplyr::count()

# Add to sce
sce$astir_immune_type <- astir_type$cell_type[match(sce$cell_id, astir_type$ID)]

# Create combined category
sce$astir_immune_combined <- ifelse(sce$astir_immune_type %in% c("Unknown","Other"), "Unknown/Other", sce$astir_immune_type)

sce$astir_immune_combined[sce$astir_immune_combined %in% c("Myeloid")] <- "Macrophage"

#Mark channels used for cell type assignment 
astir_immune_channel = c("CD3","CD4","CD8a", "CD68", "CD11c", "MPO", "CD31/vWF", "SMA", "CD38","CD20")

rowData(sce)$use_astir_immune <- rowData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% mutate(use_astir = ifelse(rownames(sce) %in% astir_immune_channel,TRUE,FALSE)) %>% pull(use_astir)
```

Metacluster Categories based on Graph110


```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering, astir and GMM

### 1. Heatmap body ###

# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
sce$cluster_selected <- sce$cluster_110
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",

other_immune <- c("GATA3", "TMEM173", "4-1BB", "IRF4", "CD279", "CD73", "CD7", "GranB", "CD274", "EOMES", "FOXP3", "CD278", "CXCL13", "GITR", "CD134", "Tbet", "Tim-3", "NKG2A", "GranK")
 
rowData(sce)$other_immune <- rownames(sce) %in% other_immune

other_mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster_selected,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$other_immune)

# Heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)

### 2. Heatmap annotation ###

### 2.1 Spatial features

#dplyr::select spatial features and average over cluster_selecteds 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, cluster_selected)
spatial <- spatial %>% dplyr::select(-cluster_selected) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster_selected = spatial$cluster_selected), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Define color schemes for spatial features and add to metadata
area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$area <- area_col

eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Astir/GMM prediction

### 3. Assign labels to clusters 

max_marker_astir

# assign cluster to its max marker expression if > 0.5

anno <- colData(mean_sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected, ncells)
```

```{r}
library(CATALYST)

# Run FlowSOM and ConsensusClusterPlus clustering
set.seed(220410)
sub <- CATALYST::cluster(sub, 
               features = rownames(sub)[rowData(sub)$sub_cluster],
               maxK = 30)

# Assess cluster stability
delta_area(sub)

delta_area(sub)+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,0.01), xlim = c(1, 20))
```

Cluster stability testing and comparison

```{r}
#Over different resolution parameters - Silhouette width [-1,1,max], Purity[0,1,max], Root-mean-squared difference [min]
# sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/sce_05_ccRCC.rds")


my_clusters <- colnames(colData(sub))[str_detect(colnames(colData(sub)),"cluster_sub_[:digit:]")]

df_1 <- foreach(i = seq_along(my_clusters),.combine = rbind) %do% {
num_clus <- length(unique(colData(sub)[,my_clusters[i]]))
sil <- approxSilhouette(t(assay(sub, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sub)[,my_clusters[i]])
rmsd <- clusterRMSD(t(assay(sub, "exprs")), clusters=colData(sub)[,my_clusters[i]])
data.frame(num_clus = num_clus,
           k = as.numeric(str_split(my_clusters[i],"_",simplify = TRUE)[,3]), 
           sil = mean(sil$width), 
           rmsd = sum(rmsd),
           type = "cluster_som")
}

p1 <- ggplot(df_1, aes(x=k, y=num_clus, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, num_clus), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, num_clus))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  guides(color = "none")

p_rmsd_FS <- ggplot(df_1, aes(x=k, y=rmsd, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, rmsd), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, rmsd))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df_1$k), max(df_1$k), by = 1))+
  labs(x="cluster size", y="RMSD")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_sil_FS <- ggplot(df_1, aes(x=k, y=sil, color = type))+
  geom_point(aes(k, sil), size = 3)+
  geom_line(aes(k, sil))+
  theme_classic()+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df_1$k), max(df_1$k), by = 1))+
  labs(x="cluster size", y="silhouette width")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

  
p1+p_rmsd_FS+p_sil_FS

df_1[order(df_1$k),]
```

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
metadata(sub)$colors$eccentricity <- eccentricity_col

n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))
metadata(sub)$colors$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors_col

    area = spatial$area,
```

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sub)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sub)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sub)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 2.2 Astir/GMM prediction 

## Astir cell types per cluster
astir_anno <- colData(sub) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,astir_immune_combined) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = astir_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

astir_anno_df <- astir_anno%>%as.data.frame()
max_marker_astir <- apply(astir_anno_df, 1, function(x) names(astir_anno_df)[which.max(x)])

#Create colors for astir cell types 
astir_col <- setNames(
  c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C", "#E31A1C", "#FB9A99", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6"),
  c("CD4_T_cell", "CD8_T_cell", "Endothelial", "Stromal", "Macrophage","Neutrophil", "Plasma_cell","B_cell","Unknown/Other"))

metadata(sub)$colors$astir_col <- astir_col
metadata(sub)$colors$astir_col <- metadata(sub)$colors$astir_col[match(colnames(astir_anno),names(metadata(sub)$colors$astir_col))]


## GMM cell types per cluster
GMM_anno <- colData(sub) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,GMM_immune_combined) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = GMM_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

#Create colors for GMM cell types 
GMM_col <- setNames(
  c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C", "#E31A1C", "#FB9A99", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6"),
  c("CD4_T_cell", "CD8_T_cell", "Endothelial", "Stromal", "Macrophage","Neutrophil", "Plasma_cell","B_cell","Unknown/Other"))

metadata(sub)$colors$GMM_col <- GMM_col
metadata(sub)$colors$GMM_col <- metadata(sub)$colors$GMM_col[match(colnames(GMM_anno),names(metadata(sub)$colors$GMM_col))]


ha_astir_GMM <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  astir_immune_combined = anno_barplot(astir_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sub)$colors$astir_col)),
  GMM_immune_combined = anno_barplot(GMM_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sub)$colors$GMM_col)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(3,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

### 2.3 Metadata features

#Number of cells per cluster_selected 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sub) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected, ncells)

# # Number of contributing patients (at least 5 cells)
cluster_PID <- colData(sub) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,PID) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>5) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

# Proportion of ISUP grade per cluster
ISUP <- colData(sub) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,ISUP) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
ISUP <- ISUP %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
ISUP <- ISUP %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = ISUP,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")

# Proportion of pT stage per cluster
pT <- colData(sub) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,pT_simple) %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
pT <- pT %>% group_by(cluster_selected) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
pT <- pT %>% dplyr::select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = pT_simple,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")


ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(ISUP = anno_barplot(ISUP, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sub)$colors$ISUP)),
                            pT = anno_barplot(pT, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sub)$colors$pT_simple)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),

                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,

ha_metacl <- HeatmapAnnotation(metacluster = rownames(spatial),

                                which = "row")

### 4. Plot combined Heatmap
h_recultering_agg <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sub, "min_max")),

  Heatmap(scale(t(assay(mean_sub, "min_max"))), name = "scaled min_max")+

lgd_2 <- Legend(title = "GMM", at = names(metadata(sub)$colors$GMM_col),

legends_reclustering_agg <- list(lgd, lgd_2)

# Draw heatmap
```

# 5. Final Immune metacluster 

#### Defintion

For downstream analysis, we will use Graph - SOM - Astir - GMM based immune metacluster assignment. 

first GMM them Astir
```{r ana_cat}
# Use 1. GMM and then 2. Astir for Unknown/Other category 
sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% 
  dplyr::select(pre_immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10, GMM_immune_combined) %>% 
  mutate(immune_metacluster = ifelse(sce$pre_immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10 == "Unknown/Other", ifelse(sce$GMM_immune_combined != "Unknown/Other", sce$GMM_immune_combined, "Unknown/Other"), unfactor(sce$pre_immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10))) %>% pull(immune_metacluster)

sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM  <- factor(sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM )

sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM_astir  <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% 
  dplyr::select(immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM , astir_immune_combined) %>% mutate(immune_metacluster = ifelse(sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM  == "Unknown/Other", ifelse(sce$astir_immune_combined != "Unknown/Other", sce$astir_immune_combined, "Unknown/Other"), unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM ))) %>% pull(immune_metacluster)

sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM_astir <- factor(sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM_astir) 

# Counts per category
colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM) %>% dplyr::count()
# Counts per category
colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM_astir) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM_astir) %>% dplyr::count()
```

```{r}
sce$immune_metacluster <- unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster_G110_SOM10_GMM_astir)

sce$immune_metacluster[sce$immune_metacluster == "Unknown/Other"] <- "Unknown_Other"
sce$immune_metacluster <- factor(sce$immune_metacluster) 

#Create colors for astir cell types 
immune_meta_col <- setNames(
  c("#A6CEE3", "#1F78B4", "#B2DF8A", "#33A02C", "#E31A1C", "#FB9A99", "#FDBF6F", "#FF7F00", "#CAB2D6"),
  c("CD4_T_cell", "CD8_T_cell", "Endothelial", "Stromal", "Macrophage","Neutrophil", "Plasma_cell","B_cell","Unknown_Other"))

metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster <- immune_meta_col
```

## Marker expression between Tumor/Non-Tumor

```{r}
library(ggridges)

# dplyr::select categories and markers
use_markers <- c("SMA", "CD8a", "CD68", "CD4", "CD31/vWF", "CD20", "CD38", "MPO")
categories <- c("Macrophage", "Neutrophil", "CD4_T_cell", "CD8_T_cell", "B_cell", "Plasma_cell", "Stromal", "Endothelial")

# FUNCTION
df_per_category <- function(sce, category, use_markers) {
  # Subset sce based on analysis category
  sce_subset <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster == category]
  
  # Extract expressions using specified markers and transpose the matrix
  df_subset <- t(unname(assay(sce_subset, "exprs")[use_markers,]))
  df_subset <- as.data.frame(df_subset)
  colnames(df_subset) <- use_markers
  
  # Convert from wide to long format
  df_subset <- df_subset %>%
    rownames_to_column("Sample") %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -Sample,
      names_to = "Marker",
      values_to = "exprs"
    )
  
  # Add condition column based on the subset category
  df_subset$Condition <- category
  
  return(df_subset)
}

# Initialize an empty data frame to store results
df_out <- data.frame(Sample = character(), Marker = character(), exprs = numeric(), Condition = character())

# Apply function to categories
for (category in categories){
  df <- df_per_category(sce, category, use_markers)
  df_out <- rbind(df_out, df)
}

# Specify order of Markers to plot
df_out$Marker <- factor(df_out$Marker, levels = use_markers)


# plot
ggplot(df_out, aes(x = exprs, y = Marker, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 5, alpha = 0.7) +
  xlim(c(0, 3)) +
  labs(title = "Density Ridge Plot",
       x = "Expression",
       y = "Markers") +
  theme_ridges(grid = FALSE) +  # remove default grid lines 
  theme_classic()+
  scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)
```


#### Complex fraction stacked barplot

```{r}
## PID immune_metacluster fraction dataframe
PID_immune_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(immune_metacluster,PID)  %>% group_by(PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame %>% filter(immune_metacluster != "Unknown_Other")
PID_immune_metacluster <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))
cur_df <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID", names_from = "immune_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

# Perform hierarchical clustering on fractions
dd <- dist(cur_df, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(dd, method = "ward.D2")
plot(hc)
row_sorted <- hc$order

# Define annotation dataframe
cur_df <- cur_df[row_sorted,]
anno <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(PID, gender, age_bin, ISUP_combined, pT_combined, necrose) %>% unique()
anno <- anno[match(rownames(cur_df), anno$PID),]

col_vector <- metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster[names(metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster) %in% (cur_df %>% colnames)]
cur_df <- cur_df[, names(col_vector)]

# Plot annotation dataframe with ComplexHeatmap
fraction_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  MC_fractions = anno_barplot(cur_df, gp=gpar(fill=col_vector),
                                   bar_width = 1,
                                   height = unit(25,"cm"),
                                   width = unit(11,"cm"),
                                   show_row_names = FALSE), 
                          PID = anno_simple(anno$PID, col=metadata(sce)$colors$PID, border=TRUE),
  gender = anno_simple(anno$gender, col = metadata(sce)$colors$gender, border = TRUE),
                          age = anno_simple(anno$age_bin, col = metadata(sce)$colors$age_bin, border = TRUE),
                          # grade = anno_simple(anno$ISUP_combined, col = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined, border = TRUE),
                          # pT = anno_simple(anno$pT_combined, col=metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined, border=TRUE),
                          # necrose = anno_simple(anno$necrose, col=metadata(sce)$colors$necrose, border=TRUE),
                          border = TRUE, 
                          #annotation_name_rot = 90,
                          gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                          which = "row")

# Create legends for annotation 
lgd_1 <- Legend(title = "Immune MC", 
              at = names(metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster), 
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster))

fraction_legend_list <- list(lgd_1)

# Draw heatmap
draw(fraction_anno + NULL, annotation_legend_list = fraction_legend_list)
```

##### Proportion of T cells to all immune cells

```{r}
cur_df <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(PID, immune_metacluster) %>% group_by(PID,immune_metacluster) %>% summarise(n= n()) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(prop = n/sum(n)) %>% filter(immune_metacluster %in% c("CD8_T_cell", "CD4_T_cell"))

sce$prop_Tcell_immune_PID <- cur_df$prop[match(sce$PID, cur_df$PID)]
```

visualise
```{r}
library(ggpubr)

cur_df <- colData(sce)%>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(PID,prop_Tcell_immune_PID, ISUP, pT_simple, necrose, ISUP_combined, pT_combined, PDL1_score) %>% group_by(PID) %>% slice(1) %>%   ungroup()

# Replace NA with "Unknown" to access colors in metadata
cur_df$ISUP[is.na(cur_df$ISUP)] <- "Unknown"
cur_df$pT_simple[is.na(cur_df$pT_simple)] <- "Unknown"
cur_df$necrose[is.na(cur_df$necrose)] <- "Unknown"
cur_df$ISUP_combined[is.na(cur_df$ISUP_combined)] <- "Unknown"
cur_df$pT_combined[is.na(cur_df$pT_combined)] <- "Unknown"
cur_df$PDL1_score[is.na(cur_df$PDL1_score)] <- "Unknown"

# Convert df columns into a factor with explicit levels including "Unknown"
cur_df$ISUP <- factor(cur_df$ISUP, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, "Unknown"))
cur_df$pT_simple <- factor(cur_df$pT_simple, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, "Unknown"))
cur_df$necrose <- factor(cur_df$necrose, levels = c(0, 1, "Unknown"))
cur_df$ISUP_combined <- factor(cur_df$ISUP_combined, levels = c("1/2", "3/4", "Unknown"))
cur_df$pT_combined <- factor(cur_df$pT_combined, levels = c("1/2", "3/4", "Unknown"))
cur_df$PDL1_score <- factor(cur_df$PDL1_score, levels = c(0, 1, "Unknown"))

# ISUP
ggplot(data = cur_df, aes(x = ISUP, y = prop_Tcell_immune_PID, fill = ISUP)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP) +  # Use Scale_fill_manual => factors levels need to be present
  labs(title = "Proportion of T cells/Immune cells per Patient divided by ISUP grade",
       x = "ISUP Grade",
       y = "Tcell/Immune cell Proportion") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)
  )

# ISUP combined
Tcell_prop_ISUP <- ggplot(data = cur_df %>% filter(ISUP_combined != "Unknown"), 
       aes(x = ISUP_combined, y = prop_Tcell_immune_PID, fill= ISUP_combined)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined)+
  labs(x = "ISUP_combined Grade",
       y = "Tcell/Immune cell Proportion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5))+
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test")
```

#### Fraction correlation 

```{r}
# METACLUSTER 

## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)
SID_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(immune_metacluster,sample_id) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
SID_metacluster <- SID_metacluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_metacluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_metacluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")
cor <- cor(SID, method = "spearman")

n <- length(colnames(SID))
if(n > 1){
mean(cor[2:n,1])
}else{NA}
}

SID_metacluster_cor <- as.data.frame(SID_metacluster_cor) 
SID_metacluster_cor$PID <- unique(colData(sce)$PID) 
SID_metacluster_cor$category <- "PID"
out <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
SID_metacluster_cor$n_images <- out$n[match(SID_metacluster_cor$PID, out$PID)]

# Filter samples with 1 image only - Correlation = NA 
SID_metacluster_cor <- SID_metacluster_cor %>% filter(n_images > 1)

SID_metacluster_cor_plot <- ggplot(SID_metacluster_cor, aes(x = category, y = V1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = n_images), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 6))+
  ylab("Correlation of metacluster fractions per PID (n=2-6)")+
  ggtitle(paste("Spearman rho = ",round(median(SID_metacluster_cor$V1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))

SID_metacluster_cor_plot

#CLUSTER 
## Correlation of metacluster fractions for each PID (2-6 images per PID)
SID_cluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected,sample_id) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
SID_cluster <- SID_cluster %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

# Cluster fraction correlation for each PID
## by cluster
SID_cluster_cor <- SID_cluster
SID_cluster_cor$PID <- sce$PID[match(SID_cluster$sample_id,sce$sample_id)]

SID_cluster_cor <- foreach(i = unique(colData(sce)$PID),.combine = "rbind")%do%{
SID <- SID_cluster_cor %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% dplyr::select(-Freq,-PID) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cluster_selected,names_from = sample_id,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster_selected")
cor <- cor(SID, method = "spearman")
#cor[2] # only works for two images per patient 
n <- length(colnames(SID))
if(n > 1){
mean(cor[2:n,1])
}else{NA}
}

SID_cluster_cor <- as.data.frame(SID_cluster_cor) 
SID_cluster_cor$PID <- unique(colData(sce)$PID) 
SID_cluster_cor$category <- "PID"
out <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% count()
SID_cluster_cor$n_images <- out$n[match(SID_cluster_cor$PID, out$PID)]

# Filter samples with 1 image only - Correlation = NA 
SID_cluster_cor <- SID_cluster_cor %>% filter(n_images > 1)

SID_cluster_cor_plot <- ggplot(SID_cluster_cor, aes(x = category, y = V1))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = n_images), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color = "none")+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 6))+
  ylab("Correlation of cluster fractions per PID (n=2-6)")+
  ggtitle(paste("Spearman rho = ",round(median(SID_cluster_cor$V1, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))

SID_cluster_cor_plot
```

## Marker expression between Categories

```{r}
library(ggridges)
use_markers <- c("CD31/vWF","SMA","CD45RO", "CD45RA", "CD3","CD4","CD8a","CD38","MPO","CD11c","CD20", "CD68")

# Funciton to exptract exprs
extract_exprs <- function(sce, cat, use_markers){
  cur_sce <- sce[, sce$immune_metacluster == cat]
  cur_df <- t(unname(assay(cur_sce, "min_max")[use_markers,]))
  cur_df <- as.data.frame(cur_df)
  colnames(cur_df) <- use_markers
  cur_df <- cur_df %>% rownames_to_column("Sample") %>% pivot_longer(cols = -Sample, names_to = "Marker", values_to = "min_max")
  cur_df$Condition <- cat
  return(cur_df)
}

all_dfs <- lapply(unique(sce$immune_metacluster), function(celltype) {
  extract_exprs(sce, celltype, use_markers)
})

final_df <- do.call(rbind, all_dfs)

# plot
marker_distribution <- ggplot(final_df, aes(x = min_max, y = Marker, fill = Condition)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.7, scale = 5) + 
  xlim(c(0, 1)) +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),

    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)
```

## CATALYST-based visualization

MDS pseudobulk - MultiDimensional Scaling Pseudobulkk Analysis:
- Dimensionality reduction based on pseudobulk (Data aggregation within cell types) rather than on single cell level 
- MDS aims to represent the data in a lower-dimensional space while preserving the pairwise distances (or dissimilarities) between data points as accurately as possible

clrDR:
- Computes centered log-ratios on cluster/sample proportions across samples/clusters, and visualizes them in a lower-dimensional space (linear!), highlighting differences in composition between samples/clusters.
- PCA performed on clr transformed data


We will first convert the sce into a CATALYST-compatible format.

```{r CATALYST}
library(CATALYST)
# save spe in CATALYST-compatible object with renamed colData entries and 
# new metadata information
sce_cat <- sce 
sce_cat$sample_id <- factor(sce$PID)
sce_cat$cluster_id <- factor(sce$immune_metacluster)

#add celltype information to metadata
metadata(sce_cat)$cluster_codes <- data.frame(immune_metacluster = factor(sce_cat$immune_metacluster))
```

```{r CATALYST pbmds and clrDR, message=FALSE}
# MDS pseudobulk 
## by immune_metacluster
pbMDS(sce_cat, by = "cluster_id", 
      features = rownames(sce_cat)[rowData(sce_cat)$sub_cluster],
      label_by = "cluster_id", k = "immune_metacluster") +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  theme_classic()


# CLR of patient proportions per myeloid_metacluster
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "cluster_id", k = "immune_metacluster", 
      label_by = "cluster_id", arrow_col = "PID", 
      point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$immune_metacluster, 
      arrows = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  theme_classic()


# CLR of immune_metacluster proportions per patient
clrDR(sce_cat, dr = "PCA", 
      by = "sample_id", point_col = "sample_id",
      k = "immune_metacluster", point_pal = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$PID)+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce_cat)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  theme_classic()
```

#### Differential expression analysis 

```{r}
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# T cell category
sce$Tcell_other <- ifelse(sce$immune_metacluster %in% c("CD4_T_cell","CD8_T_cell"), "T_cells","Other")

# T cell relevant markers 
other_immune <- c("GATA3", "TMEM173", "4-1BB", "IRF4", "CD279", "CD73", "CD7", "GranB", "CD274", "EOMES", "FOXP3", "CD278", "CXCL13", "GITR", "CD134", "Tbet", "Tim-3", "NKG2A", "GranK")

# 1. Aggregate expression per PID and category 
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce,
                                 ids = DataFrame(sce$PID, sce$Tcell_other),
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "exprs")

# 2. Calculate log2FC 
## Aggregate per category 
mean_sce_1 <- aggregateAcrossCells(mean_sce, 
                     ids = mean_sce$sce.Tcell_other, 
                     statistics = "mean",
                     use.assay.type = "exprs")

logFC <- log2(assay(mean_sce_1, "exprs")[,mean_sce_1$sce.Tcell_other == "T_cells"]/assay(mean_sce_1, "exprs")[,mean_sce_1$sce.Tcell_other == "Other"])

# 3. Calculate p-value (based on t-test)
exprs <- as.data.frame(t(assay(mean_sce)))

exprs$Tcell_other <- mean_sce$Tcell_other

p_value <- c()
for (i in 1:(length(colnames(exprs))-1)) {
  t <- t.test(exprs[exprs$Tcell_other == "T_cells",i], exprs[exprs$Tcell_other == "Other",i])
  p_value[i] <- t$p.value
}
## Adjust p.value 
p_value_adj <- p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
names(p_value_adj) <- colnames(exprs)[1:43]

# 4. Plot VolcanoPlot 
data <- as.data.frame(cbind(logFC, p_value_adj))
#data <- data[which(rownames(data) %in% other_immune),]

keyvals <- ifelse(
   data$logFC < -0.58, "#377EB8",
      ifelse(data$logFC > 0.58, "#E41A1C",
        'black'))
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- 'black'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#E41A1C"] <- 'High T-cells'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == 'black'] <- 'Not Sig'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == "#377EB8"] <- 'High Other'
  
EnhancedVolcano(data,
    lab = rownames(data),
    x = 'logFC',
    y = 'p_value_adj',
    title = 'T-cells and non-T-cells',
    boxedLabels = TRUE,
    pCutoff = 0.0001,
    FCcutoff = 0.58,
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    pointSize = 8.0,
    labSize = 8.0, 
    colCustom = keyvals)
```

# 11. Differential abundance analysis 

## Loop over categories 

### Immune metacluster 

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

DA <- lapply(c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined","necrose","PDL1_score"), function(x){

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 

#relevant patient metadata (Re-level for baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]

if(x %in% c("necrose","PDL1_score")){
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "0")
}else{
  meta[,x] <- relevel(x=factor(meta[,x]), ref = "1/2")
}

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta[,x]),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta[,x])

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~group, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- edgeR::cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)
DA$category <- x

return(DA)
})

DA_out <- do.call(rbind, DA)
```


```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that ISUP 1/2 is baseline)

meta$ISUP_combined <- relevel(x=factor(meta$ISUP_combined), ref = "1/2")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$ISUP_combined),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$ISUP_combined)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~ISUP_combined, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$ISUP_combined))%v%
  columnAnnotation(ISUP_combined = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$ISUP_combined)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.1")+
  ggtitle("ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  xlab("logFC (ISUP 1/2 vs. 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")
```

### Tumor stage

```{r}
### Differential abundance analysis based on edgeR
library(edgeR)

abundances <- table(unfactor(sce$immune_metacluster), sce$PID)
abundances <- unclass(abundances) 
head(abundances)

#relevant patient metadata (Relevel so that pT 1/2 is baseline)
meta <- colData(sce)[match(colnames(abundances), sce$PID),]
meta$pT_combined <- relevel(x=factor(meta$pT_combined), ref = "1/2")

#filter
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$pT_combined),]
abundances <- abundances[,colnames(abundances) %in% meta$PID]

#create DGEList - based on edgeR package
y.ab <- DGEList(abundances, samples=meta, group = meta$pT_combined)

#Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~pT_combined, data = y.ab$samples)

#Visualize
# logCPM of abundances per cluster
cur_mat <- cpm(abundances,prior.count = 1,log = TRUE)

Heatmap(cur_mat, 
        col = viridis(100),
        column_split = unfactor(meta$pT_combined))%v%
  columnAnnotation(pT_combined = anno_simple(unfactor(meta$pT_combined)))


# Estimate NB and QL dispersion 
y.ab <- estimateDisp(y.ab, design, trend="none")
summary(y.ab$common.dispersion)
plotBCV(y.ab, cex=1)

fit.ab <- glmQLFit(y.ab, design, robust=TRUE, abundance.trend=FALSE)
summary(fit.ab$var.prior)
plotQLDisp(fit.ab, cex=1)

# Test for differential abundance of clusters between tumor stages
res <- glmQLFTest(fit.ab, coef=ncol(design))

res$coefficients
summary(decideTests(res))

DA <- res$table

DA <- topTags(res, n = nrow(DA), adjust.method = "BH")$table

DA <- DA %>% mutate(cluster = rownames(DA), sign = DA$FDR<0.05, result = ifelse(DA$logFC > 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "UP",ifelse(DA$logFC < 0 & DA$FDR < 0.05, "DOWN", "NOTSIG"))) %>% 
  arrange(desc(logFC))

DA$cluster <- factor(DA$cluster, levels = DA$cluster)

sig <- DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05) %>% pull(cluster) %>% unfactor

## Visualize
#Barplot
ggplot(DA, aes(cluster, y = logFC))+
  geom_col(aes(fill=result), col = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#377EB8","lightgrey","#E41A1C"))+
  ylab("logFC")+
  xlab("Cluster")+
  labs(fill = "FDR<0.05")+
  ggtitle("pT_stage (1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  theme_classic()

#Volcano plot  
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_point(aes(col=cluster, size = -log10(FDR)))+
    geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  xlab("logFC (pT: 1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  ylab("-log10(FDR)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")

#Abundance vs log fold change (best?)
ggplot(DA, aes(x = logFC, y = logCPM))+
  geom_point(aes(col= cluster, 
                 size = -log10(FDR)))+
  geom_label_repel(data = DA %>% filter(FDR<0.05), aes(label = cluster))+
  scale_color_manual(values = metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  xlab("logFC (pT: 1/2 vs 3/4)")+
  ylab("Abundance (logCPM)")+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  labs(color = "cluster")+
  xlim(-0.5, 1.2)
```

# 12. Survival analysis 

## Multivariate cox models

### Continious 

```{r cox}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_immune_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(immune_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_immune_metacluster <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "immune_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

## 1. Based on continuous cluster proportions
Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

#add covariates for correction
Cox_df$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
Cox_df$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]

Cox_df_prop <- Cox_df

#Cox_df$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df),sce$PID)])
#Based on proportions

covariates <- Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -Stromal) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ Stromal"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_prop <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_prop <- ggplot(plot_df_prop, aes(x = reorder(group,desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_prop")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_prop
```

### Mean / Median 

```{r}
library(survival)
library(survminer)

PID_immune_metacluster <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(immune_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_immune_metacluster <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq))

### Multivariate cox proportional hazard model on multiple covariates (here proportion of phenotypes)
PID_metagroups <- PID_immune_metacluster %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = "PID",names_from = "immune_metacluster",values_from = "fra") %>% column_to_rownames("PID")

Cox_df <- PID_metagroups

## Based on categories (mean or median division of cluster proportions) 

Cox_df_mean <- foreach(i = colnames(Cox_df),.combine = "cbind")%do%{
Cox_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(i)) %>% mutate(mean = ifelse(Cox_df[,i] > mean(Cox_df[,i]),"B","A")) %>% pull(mean)
}

colnames(Cox_df_mean) <- colnames(Cox_df)
rownames(Cox_df_mean) <- rownames(Cox_df)

Cox_df_mean <- as.data.frame(Cox_df_mean)

## Add covariates 
Cox_df_mean$status_OS <- sce$status_OS[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
Cox_df_mean$OS_months <- sce$OS_months[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]

#Cox_df_mean$gender <- as.factor(sce$gender[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$age <- sce$age[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)]
#Cox_df_mean$ISUP <- as.factor(sce$ISUP_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$pT <- as.factor(sce$pT_combined[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])
#Cox_df_mean$necrose <- as.factor(sce$necrose[match(rownames(Cox_df_mean),sce$PID)])

covariates <- Cox_df_mean %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS,-OS_months, -Unknown_Other) %>% colnames
multi_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~", paste(covariates, collapse = " + "),"+ Unknown_Other"))

multi_model <- coxph(multi_formula, data = Cox_df_mean)

multi_res <- summary(multi_model)

plot_df_mean <- data.frame(group = rownames(multi_res$coefficients),
                      p_value = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],2),
                      HR = signif(multi_res$coefficients[,"exp(coef)"],2),
                      CI_low = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"lower .95"],2),
                      CI_high = signif(multi_res$conf.int[,"upper .95"],2),
                      wald_test = signif(multi_res$waldtest["pvalue"],2))


#Plot hazard ratios
hr_mean <- ggplot(plot_df_mean, aes(x = reorder(group,dplyr::desc(HR)), y = HR, color = p_value < 0.05))+
geom_point(size = 4)+
geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = CI_high, ymin = CI_low))+
#coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,20))+
geom_hline(yintercept = 1,color = "black",linetype = "dashed")+
scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")+
xlab("Immune metaclusters")+
ylab("HR for con_mean")+
theme_classic()+
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

hr_mean
```

```{r}
#Assess survival impact across categories
library(survival)
library(survminer)

cur_surv <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(PID, OS_months, status_OS) %>% unique()

# Extract p-values from log-rank / direction of trend
cur_surv_logrank<- foreach(x = colnames(Cox_df_mean %>% dplyr::select(-status_OS, -OS_months)), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
  cur_surv[,x] <- Cox_df_mean[,x][match(cur_surv$PID, rownames(Cox_df_mean))]
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ", x))
  fit <- survdiff(formula, data = cur_surv)
  p_value <- 1 - pchisq(fit$chisq, length(fit$n) - 1)
  data.frame(group = x, p = p_value, obs_2 = fit$obs[2], exp_2 = fit$exp[2])
}

# Adjust p-values using BH 
cur_surv_logrank$p_adj <- p.adjust(cur_surv_logrank$p, method = "BH")

# Create and plot heatmap 
cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_logrank %>% mutate(sign = p_adj < 0.1, direction = ifelse(obs_2 > exp_2, "high", "low"), type = "survival_prob") %>% mutate(p_out = ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "high",  -log10(p_adj), ifelse(sign == TRUE & direction == "low", log10(p_adj), 0))) %>% arrange(desc(p_out))

cur_surv_plot <- cur_surv_plot %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = type, names_from = group, values_from = p_out) %>% column_to_rownames("type")

# colors
col = colorRamp2(c(min(cur_surv_plot), 0, max(cur_surv_plot)), c("#4575B4", "white", "#D73027"))

Heatmap(cur_surv_plot, col = col, border = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 1), name = "log10(FDR)")
```

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
### 3. DA Annotation
anno <- colData(mean_cur_sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% dplyr::select(cluster_selected) 
anno_DA <- anno # order
colnames(anno_DA) <- "cluster_name"
DA_output <- DA_out # adjust

## Define the categories you want to loop through
categories <- c("ISUP_combined", "pT_combined", "necrose", "PDL1_score")

results <- foreach(category = categories, .combine = 'cbind') %do% {
  subset_df <- DA_output[DA_output$category == category, ] 
  
  if (category != "ISUP_combined") {rownames(subset_df) <- sub(".$", "", rownames(subset_df))} # the other categories contain an extra letter in the original df
  
  matching_indices <- match(anno_DA$cluster_name, rownames(subset_df))
  
  # Extract information
  anno_DA[[paste0(category, "_logFC")]] <- subset_df$logFC[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("result_", category)]] <- subset_df$result[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_", category)]] <- subset_df$FDR[matching_indices]
  anno_DA[[paste0("pch_", category)]] <- ifelse(anno_DA[[paste0("FDR_",category)]] < 0.05, "*", NA) # mark significant logFC
  return(anno_DA[, c(paste0(category, "_logFC"), paste0("pch_", category), paste0("FDR_", category))])
}

anno_DA <- cbind(anno_DA, results)

## define rowsplit based on DA result
anno_DA$split = apply(anno_DA, 1, function(row) {
  if ("UP" %in% row) {
    return("UP")
  } else if ("DOWN" %in% row) {
    return("DOWN")
  } else {
    return("NOTSIG")
  }
})

# define row order
anno_DA$pval_sum <- rowSums(anno_DA[, str_detect(colnames(anno_DA),"FDR")])

row_order <- anno_DA %>% dplyr::select(split, pval_sum) %>%
  arrange(factor(split, levels = c("UP", "DOWN", "NOTSIG")), desc(pval_sum)) %>%
  mutate(Row_Order = row_number())

anno_DA$row_order <- row_order$Row_Order[match(rownames(anno_DA), rownames(row_order))]

# specify color for logFC
# col_DA = colorRamp2(c(min(DA_output$logFC), 0, max(DA_output$logFC)), c("blue", "white", "red"))
col_palette <- rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu"))
breaks_seq <- c(
  seq(min(DA_output$logFC), 0, length.out = 6)[-6], # 5 values up to but not including 0
  0,                                     # Middle value
  seq(0, max(DA_output$logFC), length.out = 6)[-1]  # 5 values starting from 0 (excluding 0)
)
col_DA <- colorRamp2(breaks_seq, col_palette)

# HeatmapAnnotation
ha_DA <- HeatmapAnnotation(# Clinical categories - make anno_simple for each category in order to specify pch
                           ISUP_combined = anno_simple(anno_DA$ISUP_combined_logFC, col=col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_ISUP_combined), 
                           pT_combined = anno_simple(anno_DA$pT_combined_logFC, col=col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_pT_combined),
                           necrose = anno_simple(anno_DA$necrose_logFC, col = col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_necrose),
                           PDL1_score = anno_simple(anno_DA$PDL1_score_logFC, col = col_DA, pch = anno_DA$pch_PDL1_score),
                           
                           # row annotation
                           which = "row",
                           width = unit(5, "cm"),
                           gap = unit(2,"mm"),
                           
                           # legend - only show 1 (how to change name from ISUP_combined to logFC?)
                           show_legend = c("pT_combined" = FALSE, "necrose" = FALSE, "PDL1_score" = FALSE),
                           annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20))

# SURV ANNOTATION
# Cox

colnames(init_df) <- "cluster_name"
init_df$cluster_name <- gsub("-", "_", init_df$cluster_name) # change special characters to "_" to match names in surv_df
```

```{r}
png(file="/mnt/central_nas/users/marllu/T_panel/data_analysis/05_sub/plots/corrleation_immune_metaclusters_MY_T_panel.png",
width=2100, height=1400, res=300) # ratio 1.5

ggplot(out_cor, aes(x = category, y = cor))+  
  geom_jitter(aes(color = immune_metacluster), size = 5)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.5)+#position=position_jitter(w=0.3,h=0.3))+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  ylab("PCC")+
  xlab("Per celltype")+
  theme_classic()+
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5,1.1))+
  ggtitle(paste("Mean PCC = ",round(mean(out_cor$cor), digits = 2)))

dev.off()
```


#### Per patient

```{r}
fraction_combined <- fraction_my %>% mutate(fra_my = fra) %>% dplyr::select(PID, immune_metacluster, fra_my) %>% mutate(PID_mc = paste0(PID, "_",immune_metacluster))

fraction_combined_1 <- fraction_T %>% mutate(fra_T = fra) %>% dplyr::select(PID, immune_metacluster, fra_T) %>% mutate(PID_mc = paste0(PID, "_",immune_metacluster))

fraction_combined$fra_T <- fraction_combined_1$fra_T[match(fraction_combined$PID_mc, fraction_combined_1$PID_mc)]
```


```{r}
PID_cor <- foreach(i = unique(fraction_combined$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
PID_out <- fraction_combined %>% filter(PID %in% i) %>% dplyr::select(- PID, - immune_metacluster, - PID_mc)
cor <- cor.test(PID_out$fra_my, PID_out$fra_T, method = "pearson")
data.frame(PID = i, cor = cor$estimate, category = "PID")
}
PID_cor
```

```{r}
ggplot(PID_cor, aes(x = category, y = cor))+  
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID), size = 3)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA)+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("PCC")+
  xlab("Per PID")+
  theme_classic()+
  #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5,1.1))+
  ggtitle(paste("Mean PCC = ",round(mean(PID_cor$cor), digits = 2)))
```
